integrity: Proof relies on published symmetric quartic half-degree theorem and explicit analytic optimization. Symbolic tests are supportive, not universal verification.
scientific_limitations: Real coordinates and ell_4 Lipschitz measurement only; 1<p<infinity in best-approximation norm; published linear projection formula may overlap with the centering subproblem, but its full text was not accessible; independent audit not performed.
title: Sharp \(\ell_4\) stability of metric projection onto a probability simplex
